data.body: POLICY ANNOTATION added by a later session, 2026-09-15. One earlier comment in this log - the Wave 1 arm-characterisation entry - states per-run unit costs for the mini-swe-agent arm as bare decimals with the currency symbol omitted. Local project policy keeps financial figures of every kind, including unit costs, out of the tracker because this branch auto-pushes to a public repository; numbers belong in the local-only reports instead. This entry ANNOTATES rather than redacts, deliberately: redaction would not unpublish anything already pushed, no proportionate tool exists (rebar comments are append-only, and the only removal paths destroy this entire 26-comment Wave 1 and Wave 2 record or require a human-only break-glass history rewrite), and the practical residual risk is propagation rather than the historical record itself. TO ANY LATER READER OR AGENT: do not carry those figures into any published writeup, summary, or downstream ticket. Cost comparisons across the four arms are maintained in the local-only report. The decision to annotate rather than redact is the study owner's to revisit; this note records that it was raised, reasoned about, and left deliberately rather than missed.
